mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4.6% triggers bearish sentiment and reduced investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.6% threshold, or t-test p > 0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators signals a robust economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies increase concurrently, or Rank IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous high supply growth (INDPRO) and inflationary pressures (CPIAUCSL) indicate peak demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the 60-day period, or Rank IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals tightening monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the 5-day period, or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.25% as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt increase in labor participation (PAYEMS) above historical levels signals potential overcapacity in the labor market, fostering bearish investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite PAYEMS crossing above 138070, or t-test p > 0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in both demand (HOUST) and overall economic activity (GDPC1) indicate strengthening consumer and business confidence, driving equity price appreciation and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and GDPC1 increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising demand (RSAFS) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals a post-crisis recovery, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the 60-day period, or Rank IC < 0.03 over the horizon.
